reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: CIV-M-PNLP - Côte d'Ivoire (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Côte d'Ivoire, Malaria, Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire (MOH - PNLP)This program has the following goals: Reduce by 75% from 2008 the number of malaria cases by 2015 and maintain through 2017. Reduce malaria related mortality to below 1/100 000 population by 2015 and maintain through 2017. The objectives of this program are: At least 80% of malaria cases are confirmed and treated according to national guidelines in public and private health facilities as well as at community level by 2015 and maintained through 2017. Increase from 33% to 80% proportion of population (including pregnant women and children U5) sleeping under an LLIN by 2015 and maintain through 2017. Increase from 40% to 80% the proportion of pregnant women who have taken at least two doses of SP by 2015 and maintain through 2017
